modelNotices.markov: A Markov chain counts and stores every transition it sees, so it is simple and exact, although its table grows quickly.
modelNotices.rnn: An RNN learns one compressed memory vector, trained by backpropagation through time.
modelNotices.embed: A model trained on word tokens; its learned vectors reveal analogies and directions.
modelNotices.gpt: A real transformer with one block of masked attention: train it here on the corpus.
